items.t: "Service EV System" warning and sudden shutdown
items.job: Diagnose EV system fault and update software
items.note: Usually covered by the 8-year/100,000-mile EV warranty. If a high-voltage part must be replaced out of warranty, cost rises sharply.

items.t: Inverter software can cut drive power (recall)
items.note: Free at any Nissan dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Inverter error check can shut the car down (recall)
items.note: Free at any Nissan dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Front motor oil leak can cut power (recall)
items.note: Free at any Nissan dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Steering wheel bolt may be loose or missing (recall)
items.note: Free at any Nissan dealer. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Front motor bolts may be overtightened after recall repair
items.job: Replace two front motor mounting bolts (service campaign)
items.note: Free under Nissan service campaign P6A01 for affected cars.

items.t: Weak 12-volt battery stops the car from powering on
items.note: Often covered in the first couple of years. Have the DC-DC converter checked too.

items.t: DC fast charging stops early or won't start
items.job: Diagnose charging fault (12V battery, DC-DC converter, charge port)
items.note: Usually a warranty repair on these model years. Parts cost extra if the charge port or converter must be replaced.

items.t: Won't charge because charge port caps are missing
items.job: Inspect charge port and fit missing terminal caps

items.t: Screens freeze, go blank or reboot
items.job: Reprogram infotainment unit and CAN gateway
items.note: Done free under Nissan service campaigns on affected cars.

items.t: Driver-assist false alerts or ProPILOT unavailable
items.job: Read driver-assist codes and align radar and camera
items.note: Cost rises a lot if a radar sensor or bracket must be replaced.
